thoughts.title: First Thoughts
thoughts.content:
I'm finally ready to call this site good enough to put up! This is one of the first things I started working on when I started learning web development, but the ascii design I wanted to go for was more involved than my surface level understanding of front-end stuff could handle for a little while- glad I finally got around to getting it to a spot I'm happy with.

I removed several wip things that I thought could be pushed down the line since I plan to give this site steady updates. I'm excited to flesh out a greenhouse section with photos of my plants, and a graffiti appreciation section with time... and hopefully I'll be posting some bloggy sort of writings here in the thought cabinet every now and then. Last minute I added a to-do list for public viewing after seeing that on someone else's site (I forget who it was, sorryy) I love exposing the creative process behind something like this.

After spending many years learning how to make games and exploring that medium with a lot of different projects, it's interesting to put my learning focus into something new and once again feel like I have no idea what's going on. It's an uncomfortable feeling that I think is good to get used to. I'm not an amazing programmer but I do really enjoy it and there's an immense depth of stuff to learn if someone chooses to, kind of reassuring to know I'll never know everything!

Thank yous

  • My partner is the one who introduced me to Neocities and their site is really cool: https://audio-sludge.neocities.org/
  • The Odin Project! Learned a lot from them: https://www.theodinproject.com/
  • A lot of the graphics for this site come from the ASCII Art Archive, they have some cool tools on there: https://www.asciiart.eu/


Thanks for stopping by and if you have a cool web project of your own, drop the link in my guestbook- would love to check out some cool stuff other folks are doing :)
